claim: A wall-aligned sprite with air behind it is not a fault: railings, gates, curtains, cobwebs, flags and bars stand free, and when seen from both sides must be two-sided (no cstat 64) and, for railings, blocking (cstat 1). Only hung things (posters, notices, boards) need a wall behind them.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-19: 'not all wall sprites will be on the wall and it doesn't mean it is wrong'; 'that balcony at station is not 2 sided sprite, so it is invisible from the other side'.
Campaign cstats copied from a sprite may carry bit 64 (E1M2's gate 8413).
use: Never refuse a free wall sprite; lint hung paper for a wall behind it.
